inspect_pytree_paths: inspect a JAX pytree and list all leaf path names with optional type annotations
flatten_pytree_paths: flatten a nested dict into compressed slash-separated keys using JAX tree utilities
print_tree_info: print dtype, shape, and total parameter count for every leaf in a JAX pytree
normalize_array: normalize a numpy array to [0,1] using percentile-based clipping per channel or globally
compute_array_stats: compute and format mean, standard deviation, min, and max statistics for an array
